thread:
zoe: FYI rolling out two billing changes effective 2026-10-01: 1) add a model SKU to every invoice line for hosted API usage, and 2) publish a 14-day billing dispute SLA for quick remediations.

zoe: Goal: make chargeback + internal cost-allocation simpler for customers and shorten dispute cycles. This is a billing metadata & ops change, not a rate-limit change.

paul: Model SKU = canonical model identifier (eg. rwd-v1-small, llama3-70b-int8)?

zoe: Yes — invoice lines will show the model SKU we used to serve the request and the quantization variant when applicable (e.g., "rwd-v1-small | q4_0"), plus per-token unit price.

ramey: How do we handle multi-model routing / ensemble calls where the request touches multiple SKUs?

zoe: We attribute tokens to the model that generated the final output. For internal toolchains that run a reranker/ensembler, billing will itemize each model invocation as a separate line. Finance added an example in the doc.

billing-bot: Example invoice excerpt:
```
2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31
Hosted API - rwd-v1-small | q4_0 - 1,200,000 tokens - $12.00
Hosted API - llama3-70b | fp16 - 300,000 tokens - $9.00
```

support-lead: For disputes: new SLA = 14 calendar days from invoice issuance to file a dispute; finance aims to acknowledge within 48 hours and resolve within 10 business days. Support macros updated.

finance-eng: We'll surface a new "model_sku" column in the billing export CSV and add a mapping table in the billing UI. Also adding a reconciliation job to backfill SKUs for the past 90 days where trace data exists.

paul: Any privacy concerns with model-level line items?

zoe: Checked with legal: this is fine. We won't expose internal perf traces; just SKU strings and token counts. For customers on sensitive contracts we can redact SKU detail on request (sales/legal coordination required).

support-lead: I'll add macros: "Your invoice now includes per-model SKUs to help with cost allocation. To file a billing dispute include invoice number, account ID, and a short reason. Disputes filed within 14 days get priority handling."

zoe: Thanks. Ops/infra: watch for billing-export performance when adding SKU joins; finance-eng will coordinate a safe rollout. If you see export timeouts tag @finance-eng.
